description: This file defines extension methods for the IClientBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically to configure Azure Queue persistent streams for the Orleans cluster client.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure Azure Queue streams on IClientBuilder instances.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Configures the cluster client to use Azure Queue persistent streams with a specified configuration action.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Overload that configures the cluster client to use Azure Queue persistent streams with options configured via a provided action.
